# apex-docx-pdf

> Deterministic, Bun-first DOCX template to searchable PDF rendering for TypeScript.

Package prerelease: read ./package.json
Engine compatibility: import ENGINE_VERSION from apex-docx-pdf
Install: bun add apex-docx-pdf@next

## Agent entry points

- Agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md
- Integration context: ./ai/CONTEXT.md
- Integration skill: ./ai/skills/integrate-apex-docx-pdf/SKILL.md
- Compatible-template skill: ./ai/skills/generate-compatible-docx-template/SKILL.md
- Template inspector: ./ai/skills/generate-compatible-docx-template/scripts/inspect-template.mjs

## Public entry points

- Recommended facade: apex-docx-pdf
- Browser client: @apexmed/browser
- Browser worker: @apexmed/browser/worker
- Optional React developer UI: @apexmed/devtools

The renderer uses a deliberately bounded DOCX profile. Always inspect and strictly compile the exact template, review every diagnostic, render with explicit locale and timeZone values, and validate representative and boundary data before deployment.

Documentation source: https://github.com/craig-bredenkamp/apex-docx-pdf/tree/main/docs
Repository: https://github.com/craig-bredenkamp/apex-docx-pdf
